A: FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet is a dietary supplement that is used to manage iron deficiency anaemia during pregnancy. Q: What are the key ingredients in FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet? A: It contains Disodium Guanosine-5-monophosphate, Ferrous Bis-Glycinate, Folic acid, and Lactoferrin as the active ingredients that help improve iron and folate reserves. Q: How does the FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet work? A: Disodium guanosine 5-monophosphate helps in decreasing the levels of hepcidin (responsible for the impairment of iron absorption) and thus promotes effective iron-mediated formation of red blood cells. Lactoferrin normalizes iron homeostasis by facilitating iron absorption and inhibiting inflammatory processes responsible for anemia. Ferrous bisglycinate is a source of dietary iron, which helps in the formation of red blood cells. Folic acid is essential for growth and development, especially during the first 12 weeks of pregnancy, to protect the baby against neural tube defects. Q: Can FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet be taken during pregnancy? A: Yes, FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet is often recommended during pregnancy to support maternal health and prevent conditions like iron deficiency anemia. Q: Can I take the FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet with other medications? A: It's important to consult your healthcare provider before taking FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet with other medications to avoid potential interactions. Q: How long should I take the FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet? A: Use the FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet throughout the pregnancy for effective results or as directed by the doctor. The duration of management with FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet varies depending on the reason for taking it. Follow your healthcare provider's recommendations. Q: What should I do if I miss a dose of FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet? A: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it's almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule. Q: Can the FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet be taken on an empty stomach? A: It's generally recommended to take the FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet after meals to reduce the risk of stomach upset. However, follow the instructions provided by your healthcare provider or on the product packaging. Q: What should I do if I experience severe side effects after taking the FERRONOMIC PLUS Tablet? A: If you experience severe allergic reactions, difficulty breathing, chest pain, or any other serious side effects, seek immediate medical attention and discontinue use of the supplement. A: Take Orokinase Tablet as advised by your physician. Excessive usage does not improve health condition and may increase the risk of side effects. Consult your doctor before taking it. Q: What is the use of Orokinase Tablet? A: Orokinase Tablet is a fibrinolytic and thrombolytic agent used for heart disease, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and stroke. Contact your doctor before taking Orokinase Tablet. Q: How does Orokinase Tablet works? A: Nattokinase works by thinning the blood and helps to break blood clots. This might protect against heart disease and conditions caused by blood clots such as stroke, heart attack, and others. Q: Who should avoid taking Orokinase Tablet to use? A: Orokinase Tablet is not recommended in patients with ischemic stroke, peptic ulcer, and bleeding disorders, as well as before and after surgery. Q: What is the side effects of Orokinase Tablet? A: There are no side effects reported with the use of Orokinase tablet. However, consult your doctor if you notice any unusual side effects while taking Orokinase Tablet. Q: Is it safe to take Orokinase Tablet during pregnancy? A: No, Orokinase Tablet is not recommended during pregnancy as there is no information on safety and efficacy. Inform your doctor if you are pregnant or planning for pregnancy before taking it. It is advisable to continue the management for some days after the clinical signs have subsided Do not use if you are allergic to any of its components Inform your doctor if you have recently taken any other medicines, including medicines obtained without a prescription, vitamin supplement or herbal products MORE INFORMATION Keep out of reach of children Store below 25°C FAQs ABOUT THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT Q: Does THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT cause reddening of skin? A: THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT may cause reddening of skin, that occurs due to increased blood flow caused by benzyl nicotinate present in the ointment. Q: How many times can I apply THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT? A: Apply THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of ointment to the affected area 2 to 3 times a day or as directed by the doctor. Q: What is THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT used for? A: THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT is an anticoagulant, used as a topical management for thrombophlebitis (swelling of a vein due to blood clot), superficial thrombosis, acute tendovaginitis, and superficial bruises and for acceleration of absorption of hematoma. Consult your doctor before using THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT. Q: Can I use THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT in open wounds? A: In open wounds such as in ulcus cruris or injuries THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT should be applied only to the outer area of the skin and not to the wound itself. Consult your doctor before use. Q: How do you apply THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT? A: Apply THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. It should be applied in a thin layer to the affected area. It can also be spread on a piece of gauze which is placed over the affected area. Do not massage or rub the ointment in thrombosis and thrombophlebitis. Avoid contact with eyes. Q: How THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT work? A: Heparin sodium is an anticoagulant which inhibits clot formation, promotes breakdown of clots and helps absorption of superficial micro clots. Benzyl nicotinate works by increasing the blood flow and increases the local absorption of heparin. Thus, it promotes healing and relives pain. Q: What are the side effects of THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT? A: Consult your doctor if you notice any unusual side effects while applying THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT. Q: Can I use THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT with other medicines? A: Inform your doctor if you have recently using any other medicines, including medicines obtained without a prescription, vitamin supplement or herbal products. Q: How to store THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT? A: THROMBOPHOB OINTMENT can be stored at room temperature. There are no specific storage instructions regarding the storage of this medicine. HOW DULCOFLEX TABLET WORKSDulcoflex contains the active ingredient bisacodyl, which stimulates the muscles in the bowel to promote bowel movement. It helps to increase the movement of the intestines, aiding in the relief of constipation. DIRECTIONS FOR USEFollow your doctor's instructions regarding the exact dosage. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage. How to Take Dulcoflex Tablets? Take 1 to 2 tablets (5-10 mg) once daily, preferably before bedtime, for overnight relief. Swallow the tablet whole with water. Do not crush or chew, as it can irritate the stomach lining. Avoid taking it with milk, antacids, or within 1 hour of consuming these, as they can reduce the medication’s effectiveness. Drink plenty of water to aid the laxative’s effect and prevent dehydration. Dosage Instructions for Adults and Children: For adults and children over 10 years, take one tablet daily in the evening before bedtime. For children, the dosage may vary based on age and weight. Always consult your doctor before giving it. Fo children aged below 10 years, consult your child’s doctor for advice. How Long Does It Take to Work? Typically, it takes 6 to 12 hours for Dulcoflex tablet to show results. It is best taken at bedtime for overnight relief. For best results, follow the recommended dosage and instructions on the packaging or as directed by your doctor. Always stay hydrated and maintain a balanced diet to support regular bowel movements. composition: Clotrimazole FAQs ABOUT CANDID CREAMQ: What is CANDID CREAM used for? A: CANDID CREAM is used in the management of fungal skin infections such as ringworm (a fungal infection of the skin or scalp), athlete’s foot (a fungal infection between the toes), fungal nappy rash (a skin rash affecting the nappy area), and fungal sweat rash. It also relieves irritation of the vulva or at the end of the penis, which may be associated with thrush. Q: How does CANDID CREAM work? A: CANDID CREAM acts by inhibiting the biosynthesis of ergosterol and other sterols (enzymes) required for cell membrane production; therefore, it inhibits the division and growth of fungi, eventually leading to cell death, which further manages fungal growth. Q: What are the side effects of CANDID CREAM? A: The side effects that can be associated with the use of CANDID CREAM are itching, rash, blisters, burning, discomfort, swelling, irritation, tingling or prickling sensation, redness, and peeling of the skin. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effects get worse. Q: Can CANDID CREAM be used on children? A: No, the safety and effectiveness of CANDID CREAM are not established in children. Consult the child’s doctor to select a suitable alternative therapy for your child, depending on the type of infection. Q: Does CANDID CREAM cause an allergic reaction? A: CANDID CREAM may cause allergic reactions rarely in some individuals. Signs include rash, swelling of the lips, throat, tongue, or face, feeling faint or dizzy, weakness, nausea, and swallowing or breathing problems. If you experience this effect, consult your doctor immediately. Q: Who should avoid taking CANDID CREAM? A: CANDID CREAM is advised not to be used by individuals who are allergic to its ingredients or have nail or scalp infections. Consult your doctor before taking this medicine. Q: What if I miss a dose of CANDID CREAM? A: If you miss using a dose of CANDID CREAM, apply it as soon as you notice. However, skip that dose if it's almost time for the next one. Do not apply it two times to make up for the missed dose. Q: How do you use CANDID CREAM? A: Always apply CANDID CREAM as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Clean and dry the affected surface before applying the medicine. Apply and gently rub a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Wash your hands before and after applying the medicine. Do not use CANDID CREAM on your face, eyes, or large areas. Do not use under bandages or for a long time without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the duration and time interval for the application, depending on the type of infection. Q: Can I use CANDID CREAM when I’m pregnant? A: CANDID CREAM must be used with great caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking. Your doctor will decide whether you should use this medicine or not. Q: Can CANDID CREAM be used to manage pimples? A: No. CANDID CREAM is only used to manage fungal skin infections such as athlete’s foot, ringworm, fungal nappy rash, fungal sweat rash, and thrush. Daktarin Gel is an Antifungal, used to manage fungal skin infections on the hands, feet, outer ear, trunk or groin and includes athlete’s foot), jock itch, pityriasis (tinea versicolor) and intertrigo. It is also effective against infected nappy rash. Consult your doctor before using it. When should I stop using Daktarin Gel? Stop using Daktarin Gel if you notice any skin sensitivity or irritation and consult your doctor. What precautions must be taken while applying Daktarin Gel? Avoid contact with eyes and do not smoke or go near naked flames due to risk of severe burns. Fabric (clothing, bedding, dressings, etc) that has been in contact with this product burns more easily and is a serious fire hazard. Washing clothing and bedding may reduce product build-up but not totally remove it. Can I stop using Daktarin Gel when my symptoms improve? Always apply Daktarin Gel as advised by your physician. Continue management until the lesions have completely healed. Otherwise, your symptoms may return. How long can I use Daktarin Gel? The duration of therapy varies from 2 to 6 weeks depending on the localisation and severity of the lesion. Management should continue for at least one week after the disappearance of all signs and symptoms. What if I forget to use Daktarin Gel? If you forget to use a dose, use the next dose when needed. Do not use a double dose. SAFETY ADVICE Always use Esava Soap as advised by the doctor Rub Esava Soap to the wet body gently to make a rich lather and leave for few minutes before washing off completely. Generally, it can be used once daily till the management. For external use only Avoid contact with eyes, eyelids or mucous membrane. In case if it accidentally enters the eye rinse with excess water Do not use Esava Soap if you are allergic to any of its components Inform your doctor if you are using or have recently used any other medicines including prescription, over the counter medications, as well as herbal products MORE INFORMATION Keep Esava Soap out of reach of children Store at room temperature FAQs ABOUT ESAVA SOAPQ: What is Esava Soap used for? A: Esava Soap is an anti-fungal medicated soap that is used to manage tinea versicolor (common fungal infection that causes small, discoloured patches of skin). Also, it is used as an adjuvant therapy with various oral and topical anti-fungal agents to manage recurrence of tinea and candida skin infection. Q: How should I use Esava Soap? A: Always use Esava Soap as advised by the doctor. It is for external use only. Rub Esava Soap to the wet body gently to make a rich lather and leave for few minutes before washing off completely. Q: How does Esava Soap work? A: Ketoconazole works by killing the fungi by disrupting the production of ergosterol, which is an essential component of fungal cell membrane, as a result the cell membrane of the fungi gets disrupted leading to the death of the fungi. Q: Does Esava Soap cause any side effects? A: No, it does not cause any unusual effects when used as per the advice of the doctor. Consult your doctor if you notice any unusual side effects while using Esava Soap. Q: Can I use other products along with Esava Soap? A: Inform your doctor if you are using or have recently used any other medicines including prescription, over the counter medications, as well as herbal products because it might affect the way how it works. A: Ketovate Cream is an antifungal cream containing ketoconazole as an active ingredient that is used to manage fungal and yeast infections of the skin in adults. Consult your doctor before using it. Q: What are the possible side effects of Ketovate Cream? A: Ketovate Cream may cause burning sensation, bleeding, discomfort, dryness, inflammation and tingling in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while using it. Q: How often should I apply Ketovate Cream? A: Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of Ketovate Cream for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection. composition: Cholestyramine THERAPEUTIC USES OF CHOLTRAN SACHETUsed to lower your body’s level of cholesterol which can cause heart disease prevent some types of diarrhoea or itching SIDE EFFECTS OF CHOLTRAN SACHETCholtran Sachet might cause constipation in some individuals. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while taking it. SAFETY ADVICE Always take Choltran Sachet as advised by your physician Mix the powder with milk, thin soups, fruit smoothies, sauces (Ex. apple sauce) or water, stir well and consume the mixture immediately Do not mix with too much hot or cold water Do not take it in its dry form as it may cause you to choke Do not take Choltran Sachet if you are allergic to any of its components Keep your alcohol intake within the recommended limits as advised by your doctor, as alcohol can increase your cholesterol level Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breast-feeding Choltran Sachet should not be used for children below 6 years of age Inform your doctor if you have bile duct being completely blocked, or a family history of high cholesterol levels Inform your doctor on all the medicines you use, including prescription, over-the-counter medications and herbal supplements MORE INFORMATION Keep out of reach of children Store in a cool, dry place, away from light FAQs ABOUT CHOLTRAN SACHETQ: What are the benefits of Choltran Sachet? A: Choltran Sachet is a health supplement containing cholestyramine, used to lower your body’s level of cholesterol (a type of fat) which can cause heart disease. It may also help stop some types of diarrhoea or itching. Consult your doctor before taking it. Q: How do you take Choltran Sachet? A: Always take Choltran Sachet as advised by your physician. Mix the powder with milk, thin soups, fruit smoothies, sauces (Ex. apple sauce) or water, stir well and consume the mixture immediately. Do not mix with too much hot or cold water. Do not take it in its dry form as it may cause you to choke. Q: Can I take Choltran Sachet daily? A: Consult your doctor before taking Choltran Sachet daily because prolonged use may cause side effects. If there is no improvement in your condition or if your symptoms worsen after taking it for several days, please contact your doctor. Q: Can I stop taking Choltran Sachet if I feel better? A: Continue taking Choltran Sachet until your doctor tells you to stop, unless you experience any unwanted effects, worsening of your condition or any new symptoms. Contact your doctor in such case. Q: Can I take other medicines with Choltran Sachet? A: It is important that other medicines are taken at a different time to your dose of Choltran Sachet. Any other medicines should be taken at least one hour before you take this medicine or 4–6 hours after you have taken it. This is because Choltran Sachet may change the effects of other medicines by stopping them from working so well. Consult your doctor for advice. SAFETY ADVICE Always take Mirapause Tablet exactly as advised by your doctor Swallow the tablet with a glass of water, do not crush or chew It is advised to take one tablet twice in a day or as directed by your physician Do not exceed the daily recommended dosage Do not take this medicine if you are allergic to any of its ingredients Inform your doctor on all the medicines you use including prescription, non-prescription and herbal supplements MORE INFORMATION Keep Mirapause Tablet out of sight and reach of children Store at room temperature FAQs ABOUT MIRAPAUSE 5 TABLETQ: What is Mirapause Tablet and why is it prescribed? A: It is used to relieve menopausal symptoms in women. It helps to reduce the frequency of hot flashes and to relieve muscle pain and discomfort associated with menopause. Consult a doctor before taking it. Q: How to take Mirapause Tablet? A: Always take this medicine exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow Mirapause Tablet with a glass of water. It is advised to take one tablet twice in a day or as directed by your physician. Q: Does Mirapause Tablet helps to manage breast cancer? A: Mirapause Tablet contains Daidzein, which mimics oestrogen in the body. It blocks breast cancer progression by slowing down cell proliferation and inducing apoptosis. So it may help to manage hormone-dependent cancers such as breast cancer. Consult a doctor before taking it. Q: Can I take Mirapause Tablet to relieve muscle pain during menstruation? A: Yes. It helps to relieve muscle pain and discomfort associated with menopause in women. Consult a doctor before taking it. Q: What if I miss the dose of Mirapause Tablet? A: If you happen to miss a dose, then take Mirapause Tablet as soon as you remember. However, if it’s time for the next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and follow your usual dosage. Do not double the dose. composition: Amlodipine Hydrochlorothiazide Telmisartan USES OF CORTEL TRIO TABLET Hypertension (high blood pressure) Key Benefits of CORTEL TRIO TABLET for Hypertension: Effective Blood Pressure Management: Combines Telmisartan and Amlodipine to lower and maintain blood pressure, reducing strain on the heart. Protects Against Heart and Kidney Complications: Helps prevent heart attacks, strokes, and kidney damage caused by uncontrolled hypertension. Improves Blood Circulation: Relaxes blood vessels for smoother blood flow, reducing symptoms like dizziness and headaches. Convenient Once-Daily Dose: Simplifies hypertension treatment with a single, easy-to-take tablet for better adherence. HOW CORTEL TRIO TABLET WORKSCORTEL TRIO TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema). Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood. DIRECTIONS FOR USEHow to use CORTEL TRIO TABLET for high blood pressure: Take CORTEL TRIO TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Dosage and Administration: The recommended dosage is determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to treatment. CORTEL TRIO TABLET can be taken with or without meals. Take this medicine at the same time each day to maintain a steady level of medication in your body. Avoid Nighttime Doses: As this medicine contains a diuretic, avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent excessive urination at night. Missed Dosage instructions for CORTEL TRIO TABLET: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one. Overdosage instructions for CORTEL TRIO TABLET: Taking more than the prescribed dose may lead to serious symptoms such as severe dizziness, fainting, or a significant drop in blood pressure. In case of suspected overdose, seek immediate medical attention or visit the nearest emergency room. Doctor’s Advice for Stopping CORTEL TRIO TABLET: Stopping this medication suddenly can cause your blood pressure to rise significantly, increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke. Always consult your doctor before discontinuing the medication. They may gradually reduce your dose if necessary. Key Tips for Taking CORTEL TRIO TABLET: Stay hydrated to prevent side effects like muscle cramps, dry mouth, or weakness. Follow your doctor’s advice on lifestyle changes such as a low-salt diet, regular exercise, and stress management to improve the effectiveness of the medication. SIDE EFFECTS OF CORTEL TRIO TABLETLike all medicines, CORTEL TRIO TABLET may cause certain side effects, although not everybody gets them. Possible side effects of CORTEL TRIO TABLET are: Headache and Dizziness Fatigue and Tiredness Taste Changes Diarrhea and Flu-Like Symptoms Sinusitis (Nasal Congestion Muscle Weakness and Cramps Dry Mouth and Increased Thirst If any of these side effects persist, worsen, or become bothersome, consult your doctor immediately. When to Seek Medical Attention for CORTEL TRIO TABLET Side Effects: Stop taking CORTEL TRIO TABLET and consult your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: Allergic Reactions: Symptoms like rash, itching, swelling (especially of the face, tongue, or throat), severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing. Low Blood Pressure (Hypotension): Can cause fainting, extreme dizziness, or lightheadedness, especially after standing up. Electrolyte Imbalance: Symptoms include muscle weakness, irregular heartbeat, confusion, or severe dehydration due to excessive urination. To know more about the adverse reactions for amlodipine+hydrochlorthiazide+telmisartan, refer package insert HOW TO MANAGE SIDE EFFECTSDizziness Or Drowsiness Rise Slowly: When standing up, do so gradually to prevent sudden drops in blood pressure, which can cause dizziness. Monitor Blood Pressure: Regularly check your blood pressure to ensure it's within a healthy range and discuss any concerns with your doctor. Dry Mouth Stay Hydrated: Drink water frequently to relieve dry mouth and avoid dehydration. Use Sugar-Free Lozenges or Gum: These can help stimulate saliva production and keep your mouth moist. Avoid Caffeine and Alcohol: These can worsen dry mouth, so it's best to limit their consumption. Headache Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to prevent dehydration, which can contribute to headaches. Clinical studies suggest that the components of this medication (such as amlodipine and telmisartan) can be harmful to a developing fetus. Telmisartan has been associated with fetal toxicity, and as a result, its use is contraindicated during pregnancy, especially in the second and third trimesters. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant. Pregnant women should consult their healthcare provider for safer alternatives and personalized advice regarding blood pressure management. ALCOHOLConsult your doctorAvoid consumption of alcohol while taking CORTEL TRIO TABLET as it make you feel dizzier. KIDNEYConsult your doctorCORTEL TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and anuria (low urine output). LIVERConsult your doctorCORTEL TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild liver problems. This medication, which combines amlodipine and telmisartan, is primarily used for managing hypertension in adults. A: CORTEL TRIO TABLET is a combination medication used primarily for managing hypertension (high blood pressure). It contains Amlodipine, Telmisartan and Hydrochlorothiazide. Together, these work by relaxing blood vessels to lower blood pressure, reducing the risk of heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage. CORTEL TRIO TABLET is often prescribed when other single medications for hypertension are insufficient in controlling blood pressure levels. Regular use of this medication helps in improving heart function and managing overall cardiovascular health. Q: How do I take CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: CORTEL TRIO TABLET should be taken exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. Typically, it can be taken with or without food, but it’s best to take it at the same time every day for consistency. The usual dosage is one tablet per day, but the dose may vary based on your blood pressure and response to the medication. Do not crush or chew the tablet; swallow it whole with a glass of water. Q: What are the side effects of CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: Common side effects of CORTEL TRIO TABLET include dizziness, headache, fatigue, diarrhea, and muscle cramps. Some individuals may also experience changes in taste or sinusitis. Although rare, more severe side effects like low blood pressure, electrolyte imbalances, or kidney issues can occur. If you experience any of these, or if side effects worsen, contact your healthcare provider. It's essential to stay hydrated while taking this medication to prevent dehydration and associated side effects like dry mouth and extreme thirst. Q: Can I take CORTEL TRIO TABLET during pregnancy or breastfeeding? A: CORTEL TRIO TABLET is generally not recommended during pregnancy, especially in the second and third trimesters, as it may harm the developing baby. If you're pregnant or planning to become pregnant, consult your doctor about alternative blood pressure treatments. Breastfeeding mothers should also avoid using Telma-AM H unless specifically advised by a healthcare professional. Both Telmisartan and Hydrochlorothiazide pass into breast milk, and their use could affect the nursing infant. Always seek medical advice before using any medication during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Q: What should I do if I forgot a dose of CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: If you forgot a dose of CORTEL TRIO TABLET, take it as soon as you remember, unless it’s almost time for your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose—do not take two doses at once. Missing a dose occasionally should not severely affect your treatment, but consistent adherence is key to managing high blood pressure effectively. Set reminders to help you stay on track with your daily dose, and consult your doctor if you have concerns about missed doses or need guidance on how to adjust your medication schedule. Q: Can CORTEL TRIO TABLET interact with other medications? A: Yes, CORTEL TRIO TABLET can interact with various medications, including other antihypertensive drugs, NSAIDs (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), diuretics, and diabetes medications. Potassium supplements or salt substitutes containing potassium should be used with caution, as they can increase potassium levels when taken with Telma-AM H. Additionally, if you're taking medications for kidney problems, heart issues, or other conditions, it's important to inform your doctor before starting CORTEL TRIO TABLET to avoid harmful drug interactions. Regular monitoring of kidney function and electrolytes may be required during treatment. Q: What lifestyle changes can help improve the effectiveness of CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: To maximize the benefits of CORTEL TRIO TABLET and manage hypertension effectively, it's important to make lifestyle changes alongside medication. Reduce sodium intake by avoiding processed and high-salt foods, and increase potassium-rich foods like bananas and spinach. Regular exercise, managing stress, and maintaining a healthy weight are key factors in controlling blood pressure. Limiting alcohol consumption, quitting smoking, and monitoring your blood pressure regularly also support better health outcomes. These steps complement the medication, helping you better manage hypertension and reduce cardiovascular risks. Q: Who should not take CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: CORTEL TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, severe kidney disease and anuria (low urine output), or allergic to amlodipine, hydrochlorothiazide, and telmisartan. Consult your doctor for advice. Q: What precautions must be taken while using CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: CORTEL TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a history of allergy or bronchial asthma, severe obstructive coronary artery disease, severe congestive heart failure and volume depletion, or have diabetes, eye disorders like acute myopia and acute closed-angle glaucoma, systemic lupous erythematosus, or a history of sympathectomy. Q: What are the side effects of CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: The most common side effects of taking CORTEL TRIO TABLET are fatigue, influenza-like symptoms, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, sinusitis and upper respiratory tract infection, and oedema. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen. Q: What if I forget to take a dose of CORTEL TRIO TABLET? A: If you miss a dose of CORTEL TRIO TABLET, take it as soon as possible. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and go back to your regular schedule. Do not double the dose. Q: Can I stop taking CORTEL TRIO TABLET once my blood pressure is normal? A: No, even if your blood pressure becomes normal, you should continue taking the medication as prescribed. composition: Amlodipine Hydrochlorothiazide Telmisartan USES OF ERITEL TRIO TABLET Hypertension (high blood pressure) Key Benefits of ERITEL TRIO TABLET for Hypertension: Effective Blood Pressure Management: Combines Telmisartan and Amlodipine to lower and maintain blood pressure, reducing strain on the heart. Protects Against Heart and Kidney Complications: Helps prevent heart attacks, strokes, and kidney damage caused by uncontrolled hypertension. Improves Blood Circulation: Relaxes blood vessels for smoother blood flow, reducing symptoms like dizziness and headaches. Convenient Once-Daily Dose: Simplifies hypertension treatment with a single, easy-to-take tablet for better adherence. HOW ERITEL TRIO TABLET WORKSERITEL TRIO TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema). Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood. DIRECTIONS FOR USEHow to use ERITEL TRIO TABLET for high blood pressure: Take ERITEL TRIO TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Dosage and Administration: The recommended dosage is determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to treatment. ERITEL TRIO TABLET can be taken with or without meals. Take this medicine at the same time each day to maintain a steady level of medication in your body. Avoid Nighttime Doses: As this medicine contains a diuretic, avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent excessive urination at night. Missed Dosage instructions for ERITEL TRIO TABLET: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one. Overdosage instructions for ERITEL TRIO TABLET: Taking more than the prescribed dose may lead to serious symptoms such as severe dizziness, fainting, or a significant drop in blood pressure. In case of suspected overdose, seek immediate medical attention or visit the nearest emergency room. Doctor’s Advice for Stopping ERITEL TRIO TABLET: Stopping this medication suddenly can cause your blood pressure to rise significantly, increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke. Always consult your doctor before discontinuing the medication. They may gradually reduce your dose if necessary. Key Tips for Taking ERITEL TRIO TABLET: Stay hydrated to prevent side effects like muscle cramps, dry mouth, or weakness. Follow your doctor’s advice on lifestyle changes such as a low-salt diet, regular exercise, and stress management to improve the effectiveness of the medication. SIDE EFFECTS OF ERITEL TRIO TABLETLike all medicines, ERITEL TRIO TABLET may cause certain side effects, although not everybody gets them. Possible side effects of ERITEL TRIO TABLET are: Headache and Dizziness Fatigue and Tiredness Taste Changes Diarrhea and Flu-Like Symptoms Sinusitis (Nasal Congestion Muscle Weakness and Cramps Dry Mouth and Increased Thirst If any of these side effects persist, worsen, or become bothersome, consult your doctor immediately. When to Seek Medical Attention for ERITEL TRIO TABLET Side Effects: Stop taking ERITEL TRIO TABLET and consult your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: Allergic Reactions: Symptoms like rash, itching, swelling (especially of the face, tongue, or throat), severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing. Low Blood Pressure (Hypotension): Can cause fainting, extreme dizziness, or lightheadedness, especially after standing up. Electrolyte Imbalance: Symptoms include muscle weakness, irregular heartbeat, confusion, or severe dehydration due to excessive urination. To know more about the adverse reactions for amlodipine+hydrochlorthiazide+telmisartan, refer package insert HOW TO MANAGE SIDE EFFECTSDizziness Or Drowsiness Rise Slowly: When standing up, do so gradually to prevent sudden drops in blood pressure, which can cause dizziness. Avoid Sudden Movements: If you feel dizzy, sit or lie down until the sensation passes. Monitor Blood Pressure: Regularly check your blood pressure to ensure it's within a healthy range and discuss any concerns with your doctor. Dry Mouth Stay Hydrated: Drink water frequently to relieve dry mouth and avoid dehydration. Use Sugar-Free Lozenges or Gum: These can help stimulate saliva production and keep your mouth moist. Avoid Caffeine and Alcohol: These can worsen dry mouth, so it's best to limit their consumption. Headache Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to prevent dehydration, which can contribute to headaches. Take Over-the-Counter Pain Relievers: Non-prescription pain relief medications can help alleviate mild headaches. However, consult your doctor before use. Rest in a Quiet Room: Minimize noise and light to reduce the intensity of your headache. WARNING & PRECAUTIONSPREGNANCYContraindicated ERITEL TRIO TABLET may not be safe for use during pregnancy. Clinical studies suggest that the components of this medication (such as amlodipine and telmisartan) can be harmful to a developing fetus. Telmisartan has been associated with fetal toxicity, and as a result, its use is contraindicated during pregnancy, especially in the second and third trimesters. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant. Pregnant women should consult their healthcare provider for safer alternatives and personalized advice regarding blood pressure management. BREASTFEEDINGContraindicatedStudies have shown that this medicine can pass through breast milk and its effect on the nursing infant is not well-documented. Therefore, it is not recommended for breastfeeding women?. DRIVING AND USING MACHINESUse with CautionDo not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if you feel dizzy after taking ERITEL TRIO TABLET. ALCOHOLConsult your doctorAvoid consumption of alcohol while taking ERITEL TRIO TABLET as it make you feel dizzier. KIDNEYConsult your doctorERITEL TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and anuria (low urine output). No dose adjustment is recommended for patients with mild to moderate kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it. LIVERConsult your doctorERITEL TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild liver problems. Such patients will be prescribed with a low dose and the dosage will be gradually increased. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. ALLERGYContraindicatedDo not take ERITEL TRIO TABLET if you are allergic to amlodipine, hydrochlorothiazide, telmisartan, or any other ingredients in this medicine. HEART DISEASEUse with CautionERITEL TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe obstructive coronary artery disease due to the increased risk of worsening angina and acute myocardial infarction. It is also used with caution if you have severe congestive heart failure and volume depletion due to the increased risk of developing oliguria, progressive azotemia, or acute renal failure on this medication. USE IN PEDIATRICSConsult your doctorERITEL TRIO TABLET is typically not recommended for use in pediatric patients due to a lack of established safety and efficacy data in children. This medication, which combines amlodipine and telmisartan, is primarily used for managing hypertension in adults. For pediatric use, alternative antihypertensive medications should be considered, and any treatment should be guided by a healthcare professional. USE IN GERIATRICSUse with CautionERITEL TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. Monitor Blood Pressure: Regularly check your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working properly. Avoid Alcohol and Tobacco: Both can lower the effectiveness of the medication and raise blood pressure. Hydrate Well: Drink plenty of water to reduce the risk of dizziness and dehydration. Balanced Diet: Include potassium-rich foods, low-sodium options, and limit processed food intake. Exercise: Regular physical activity helps in blood pressure management and overall heart health. Follow-Up Appointments: Regular doctor visits are essential for assessing the effectiveness and adjusting doses. INTERACTIONSA. Lithium: May increase the risk of lithium toxicity, requiring close monitoring of blood levels. A: ERITEL TRIO TABLET is a combination medication used primarily for managing hypertension (high blood pressure). It contains Amlodipine, Telmisartan and Hydrochlorothiazide. Together, these work by relaxing blood vessels to lower blood pressure, reducing the risk of heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage. ERITEL TRIO TABLET is often prescribed when other single medications for hypertension are insufficient in controlling blood pressure levels. Regular use of this medication helps in improving heart function and managing overall cardiovascular health. Q: How do I take ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: ERITEL TRIO TABLET should be taken exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider. Typically, it can be taken with or without food, but it’s best to take it at the same time every day for consistency. The usual dosage is one tablet per day, but the dose may vary based on your blood pressure and response to the medication. Do not crush or chew the tablet; swallow it whole with a glass of water. Q: What are the side effects of ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: Common side effects of ERITEL TRIO TABLET include dizziness, headache, fatigue, diarrhea, and muscle cramps. Some individuals may also experience changes in taste or sinusitis. Although rare, more severe side effects like low blood pressure, electrolyte imbalances, or kidney issues can occur. If you experience any of these, or if side effects worsen, contact your healthcare provider. It's essential to stay hydrated while taking this medication to prevent dehydration and associated side effects like dry mouth and extreme thirst. Q: Can I take ERITEL TRIO TABLET during pregnancy or breastfeeding? A: ERITEL TRIO TABLET is generally not recommended during pregnancy, especially in the second and third trimesters, as it may harm the developing baby. If you're pregnant or planning to become pregnant, consult your doctor about alternative blood pressure treatments. Breastfeeding mothers should also avoid using Telma-AM H unless specifically advised by a healthcare professional. Both Telmisartan and Hydrochlorothiazide pass into breast milk, and their use could affect the nursing infant. Always seek medical advice before using any medication during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Q: What should I do if I forgot a dose of ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: If you forgot a dose of ERITEL TRIO TABLET, take it as soon as you remember, unless it’s almost time for your next dose. In that case, skip the missed dose—do not take two doses at once. Missing a dose occasionally should not severely affect your treatment, but consistent adherence is key to managing high blood pressure effectively. Set reminders to help you stay on track with your daily dose, and consult your doctor if you have concerns about missed doses or need guidance on how to adjust your medication schedule. Q: Can ERITEL TRIO TABLET interact with other medications? A: Yes, ERITEL TRIO TABLET can interact with various medications, including other antihypertensive drugs, NSAIDs (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), diuretics, and diabetes medications. Potassium supplements or salt substitutes containing potassium should be used with caution, as they can increase potassium levels when taken with Telma-AM H. Additionally, if you're taking medications for kidney problems, heart issues, or other conditions, it's important to inform your doctor before starting ERITEL TRIO TABLET to avoid harmful drug interactions. Regular monitoring of kidney function and electrolytes may be required during treatment. Q: What lifestyle changes can help improve the effectiveness of ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: To maximize the benefits of ERITEL TRIO TABLET and manage hypertension effectively, it's important to make lifestyle changes alongside medication. Reduce sodium intake by avoiding processed and high-salt foods, and increase potassium-rich foods like bananas and spinach. Regular exercise, managing stress, and maintaining a healthy weight are key factors in controlling blood pressure. Limiting alcohol consumption, quitting smoking, and monitoring your blood pressure regularly also support better health outcomes. These steps complement the medication, helping you better manage hypertension and reduce cardiovascular risks. Q: Who should not take ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: ERITEL TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, severe kidney disease and anuria (low urine output), or allergic to amlodipine, hydrochlorothiazide, and telmisartan. Consult your doctor for advice. Q: What precautions must be taken while using ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: ERITEL TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a history of allergy or bronchial asthma, severe obstructive coronary artery disease, severe congestive heart failure and volume depletion, or have diabetes, eye disorders like acute myopia and acute closed-angle glaucoma, systemic lupous erythematosus, or a history of sympathectomy. Q: What are the side effects of ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: The most common side effects of taking ERITEL TRIO TABLET are fatigue, influenza-like symptoms, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, sinusitis and upper respiratory tract infection, and oedema. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen. Q: What if I forget to take a dose of ERITEL TRIO TABLET? A: If you miss a dose of ERITEL TRIO TABLET, take it as soon as possible. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and go back to your regular schedule. Do not double the dose. Q: Can I stop taking ERITEL TRIO TABLET once my blood pressure is normal? A: No, even if your blood pressure becomes normal, you should continue taking the medication as prescribed. Stopping it suddenly can cause a rebound increase in blood pressure, leading to serious health risks. Always consult your doctor before stopping this medication. REFERENCES1. A: Nosikind P Nasal Spray is used to relieve nasal congestion caused due to common cold, sinusitis or allergic rhinitis. Q: Can Nosikind P Nasal Spray be used every day? A: Use Nosikind P Nasal Spray for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Do not use Nosikind P Nasal Spray for more than 7 days without consulting your doctor. Prolonged use of Nosikind P Nasal Spray may worsen your condition. Q: Is it safe to use Nosikind P Nasal Spray? A: Yes. Nosikind P Nasal Spray is one of the safe and well-tolerated medicine. It does not cause any harmful side effects. It may cause local irritation or burning sensation after application which is quite normal and disappears after a few minutes. Q: What are the common side effects of Nosikind P Nasal Spray? A: The most common side effects of using Nosikind P Nasal Spray are irritation or burning sensation after application and nasal dryness. Consult your doctor if they bother you. Q: Can Nosikind P Nasal Spray be used in children? A: Nosikind P Nasal Spray can be used in children and adolescents aged 12 years or above. You must consult your doctor before using Nosikind P Nasal Spray if your child is aged 6 years or above. It is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration. Q: Is Nosikind P Nasal Spray an antihistamine? A: Nosikind P Nasal Spray is a sympathomimetic agonist which directly acts on the alpha-adrenergic receptors of the blood vessels supplying the nasal tract and narrows them down. This reduces swelling of the nasal tract and allows the air to pass through the nostrils more freely. Q: How long it takes for Nosikind P Nasal Spray to work? A: Nosikind P Nasal Spray may show its therapeutic effect after 5 to 10 minutes of application. It works by narrowing of blood vessels in the affected lining of the nose and helps to provide relief from congestion. Q: Can Nosikind P Nasal Spray cause rebound congestion? A: Yes, Nosikind P Nasal Spray may cause rebound congestion (worsening of congestion due to nasal decongestant sprays) if you use for more than the duration recommended by your doctor. A: Always take GLA-120 Capsule as advised by your physician. If there is no improvement in your condition or if your symptoms worsen after taking it for several days, please contact your doctor. Q: Can GLA-120 Capsule cause diarrhea? A: GLA-120 Capsule might cause diarrhea. Drink lots of fluids such as water or fruit juices so that you are sufficiently hydrated. If symptom persists, contact your doctor. Q: Can GLA-120 Capsule be taken during pregnancy? A: There isn't enough reliable information to know if this medicine is safe to use during pregnancy. If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or are planning for a baby, consult your doctor before taking it. Q: Can I take GLA-120 Capsule if I am about to have surgery? A: GLA-120 Capsule might slow blood clotting which might increase the risk of extra bleeding during and after surgery. Stop taking it at least 2 weeks before a scheduled surgery. A: Before taking GLA-120 Capsule, inform your doctor about your pre-existing conditions like any bleeding disorders, alcohol use, or any allergies, and about any other medicines that you might be taking. For usage and administration for children and adults, dilute with an equal volume of water and gargle or rinse thoroughly for at least 30 seconds and spit it out, do not swallow it. Repeat every two to four hours for as long as required or as directed by the doctor. Q: Is BETADINE Gargle good for cough? A: Betadine gargle is primarily intended as an antiseptic solution for oral hygiene, particularly for conditions like sore throat and mouth infections. While it may provide some relief for symptoms associated with throat irritation, it is not specifically formulated or approved for managing coughs. If you have a cough, it's essential to consult with a healthcare professional for proper diagnosis and management recommendations. They can determine the underlying cause of your cough and advise you on appropriate medications or remedies to alleviate your symptoms effectively. Q: Can I use BETADINE Gargle regularly? A: Using Betadine Mint Gargle regularly may not be recommended for everyone, as prolonged or excessive use of any antiseptic solution can potentially disrupt the natural balance of microorganisms in the mouth and throat. However, if you have been advised by a healthcare professional to use Betadine Mint Gargle regularly for oral hygiene or to manage specific conditions such as mouth infections or sore throat, it's important to follow their guidance and instructions carefully Q: Can we use BETADINE gargle for throat infection? A: Yes. Betadine Gargle can be used to manage sore throat and throat infection. Q: Is it safe to buy BETADINE gargle from online pharmacies like Netmeds in India? A: Generally, it is safe to buy BETADINE gargle from reputable online pharmacies like Netmeds. It adheres to strict regulations to ensure the quality and authenticity of the medications. A: Like any medication Betadine Gargle may cause side effects in some individuals. While small amounts of Betadine Gargle accidentally swallowed during gargling are unlikely to cause harm, ingesting larger quantities can potentially lead to adverse effects. Q: What happens if I swallow BETADINE Gargle? A: While small amounts of Betadine Gargle accidentally swallowed during gargling are unlikely to cause harm, ingesting larger quantities can potentially lead to adverse effects. If Betadine Gargle is ingested in significant amounts, it may cause symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and irritation of the digestive tract. A: Betadine Gargle is primarily used as an antiseptic solution for oral hygiene and to help manage conditions such as sore throat and mouth infections. Betadine Gargle is intended to be left in the mouth for a short period to allow its antiseptic properties to take effect. Rinsing your mouth with water immediately after using Betadine Gargle may reduce its effectiveness by washing away the antiseptic solution before it has had a chance to work. composition: ARTHORID P TABLET is a combination of Nimesulide and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs. ARTHORID P TABLET is used to provide relief from inflammation and pain in conditions such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses in affected individuals. ARTHORID P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to nimesulide, paracetamol, and/or other NSAIDS. It is also not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe liver disease, and/or severe kidney disease. Before taking ARTHORID P TABLET, inform your doctor if you are alcohol dependent and/or have other kidney problems and/or heart problems such as heart failure. ARTHORID P TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). ARTHORID P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of ARTHORID P TABLET are dizziness, excess sleepiness, stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, and/or peripheral oedema (swelling in legs or arms). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. USES OF ARTHORID P TABLET Provides relief from inflammation and pain in conditions (such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses) in affected individuals. HOW ARTHORID P TABLET WORKSARTHORID P TABLET provides relief from pain and inflammation, where nimesulide and paracetamol act by blocking the action of prostaglandin (chemical messengers responsible for pain and inflammation), resulting in reduced inflammation and providing relief from pain in affected individuals. DIRECTIONS FOR USETake ARTHORID P TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. composition: DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is a combination of Nimesulide and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs. DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is used to provide relief from inflammation and pain in conditions such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses in affected individuals. DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to nimesulide, paracetamol, and/or other NSAIDS. It is also not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe liver disease, and/or severe kidney disease. Before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are alcohol dependent and/or have other kidney problems and/or heart problems such as heart failure. DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). DOLIDE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of DOLIDE PLUS TABLET are dizziness, excess sleepiness, stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, and/or peripheral oedema (swelling in legs or arms). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. USES OF DOLIDE PLUS TABLET Provides relief from inflammation and pain in conditions (such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses) in affected individuals. HOW DOLIDE PLUS TABLET WORKSDOLIDE PLUS TABLET provides relief from pain and inflammation, where nimesulide and paracetamol act by blocking the action of prostaglandin (chemical messengers responsible for pain and inflammation), resulting in reduced inflammation and providing relief from pain in affected individuals. DIRECTIONS FOR USETake DOLIDE PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. SIDE EFFECTS OF DOLIDE PLUS TABLETCOMMON Dizziness, excess sleepiness Stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea Peripheral oedema (swelling in legs/arms) Signs of hypersensitivity reactions such as skin rash, red itchy welts, itching, and shortness of breath RAREStop taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: Signs of severe allergic reactions such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the mouth/face, and/or shortness of breath Skin rash/peeling, mouth ulcers Breathing problems, unexplained bruising/bleeding Signs of impaired liver function such as nausea, sudden weight loss, loss of appetite, and yellowing of the eyes and skin HOW TO MANAGE SIDE EFFECTSDiarrheaDrink plenty of water and stay hydrated. Try to avoid taking any medicine on your own to manage diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the diarrhea does not improve. Dizziness Or DrowsinessTry to rest and get enough sleep. Try to avoid driving or operating any tools or machines while you feel dizzy. Limit consumption of alcohol, as it can aggravate dizziness. Consult your doctor if the dizziness worsens. Nausea And VomitingTry to take DOLIDE PLUS TABLET with or just after a meal or a snack. Stick to simple meals. Avoid eating rich or spicy food. Consult your doctor if the nausea and vomiting get worse. WARNING & PRECAUTIONSPREGNANCYContraindicatedDOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Consult your doctor before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET. BREASTFEEDINGContraindicatedDOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET. DRIVING AND USING MACHINESUse with CautionDo not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, drowsy, and/or sleepy after taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET. ALCOHOLContraindicatedAvoid consumption of alcohol while taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET because it might cause liver damage. KIDNEYConsult your doctorDOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and/or analgesic nephropathy. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET. LIVERContraindicatedDOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET. ALLERGYContraindicatedDo not take DOLIDE PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to nimesulide, paracetamol, other NSAIDS, and/or other ingredients of this medicine. HEART DISEASEUse with CautionDOLIDE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET. USE IN PEDIATRICSContraindicatedDOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child. USE IN GERIATRICSUse with CautionDOLIDE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET. OTHERSDOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use if you: Have peptic ulcers and/or gastrointestinal bleeding Before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you: Are alcohol dependent INTERACTIONSA. Drug-drug interactions: Before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine: Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage blood clotting) Ex. warfarin Cholestyramine (medicine used to lower high cholesterol levels) Metoclopramide, domperidone (medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting) B. Drug-food interaction: Avoid consumption of foods containing caffeine and/or drinks such as tea, chocolate, and coffee since it leads to excessive dizziness and sleepiness. Overdosage: If you or anyone else accidentally took more of DOLIDE PLUS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. A: Yes. DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is a combination of paracetamol and nimesulide, which collectively work together for alleviating pain and inflammation. Q: Is DOLIDE PLUS TABLET used for fever? A: Although DOLIDE PLUS TABLET contains paracetamol, a fever-reducing agent, at the dosage of 325 mg, it is effective in alleviating pain and inflammation rather than reducing fever. However, it can be used to control very mild fever and body pain in exceptional circumstances. Q: Is DOLIDE PLUS TABLET good for stomach pain? A: No. Do not take DOLIDE PLUS TABLET if you have stomach pain. As DOLIDE PLUS TABLET could generally increase your stomach acid secretion, it could worsen your existing condition. Therefore, check with your doctor for managing stomach pain. Q: Can I consume two tablets of DOLIDE PLUS TABLET together for faster pain relief? A: DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is usually prescribed as one tab (2–3 times daily). Taking two tablets in one shot may lead to overdosage and unnecessary reactions. Therefore, stick to the dosage and frequency suggested by your doctor. If you feel that the prescribed dose is not working well for you, inform your doctor. Your doctor might suggest a suitable alternative. Q: Can I use DOLIDE PLUS TABLET for long-term? A: DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is usually prescribed for short-term pain management. Taking it on a long-term basis without medical supervision may severely damage your liver and overall health. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it on a long-term basis. If you are using DOLIDE PLUS TABLET based on a doctor's advice, such unnecessary side effects can be avoided. Q: Can I take DOLIDE PLUS TABLET daily? A: DOLIDE PLUS TABLET can be taken daily if requested by your doctor. However, please note that it should be followed only for a short period of time (not more than 4 weeks). Q: Does DOLIDE PLUS TABLET damage your liver? A: Prolonged or overdosage of DOLIDE PLUS TABLET has been reported to cause liver damage. Hence, use this medicine for the exact duration as advised by your doctor and stop it. Q: Is DOLIDE PLUS TABLET banned for use in children? A: DOLIDE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. Q: Does DOLIDE PLUS TABLET have side effects? A: The most common side effects of DOLIDE PLUS TABLET are dizziness, excess sleepiness, stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, and/or peripheral oedema (swelling in the legs and arms). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. Q: Can DOLIDE PLUS TABLET be used in pregnant women? A: Consult your doctor before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET if you are pregnant, as it is not known how this medicine reacts with an unborn baby. Q: Can I consume alcohol while taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET? A: Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET because it might cause liver damage. Q: What precautions must be taken while using DOLIDE PLUS TABLET? A: Before taking DOLIDE PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a kidney problem, heart failure, or alcohol dependence. Q: Who should not take DOLIDE PLUS TABLET? A: Do not take DOLIDE PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Nimesulide, Paracetamol, or other NSAIDS, or if you have severe kidney disease and/or analgesic nephropathy, liver disease, peptic ulcer, and/or gastrointestinal bleeding. composition: LUPISULIDE P TABLET is a combination of Nimesulide and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs. LUPISULIDE P TABLET is used to provide relief from inflammation and pain in conditions such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses in affected individuals. LUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to nimesulide, paracetamol, and/or other NSAIDS. It is also not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe liver disease, and/or severe kidney disease. Before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET, inform your doctor if you are alcohol dependent and/or have other kidney problems and/or heart problems such as heart failure. LUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). LUPISULIDE P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of LUPISULIDE P TABLET are dizziness, excess sleepiness, stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, and/or peripheral oedema (swelling in legs or arms). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. USES OF LUPISULIDE P TABLET Provides relief from inflammation and pain in conditions (such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses) in affected individuals. HOW LUPISULIDE P TABLET WORKSLUPISULIDE P TABLET provides relief from pain and inflammation, where nimesulide and paracetamol act by blocking the action of prostaglandin (chemical messengers responsible for pain and inflammation), resulting in reduced inflammation and providing relief from pain in affected individuals. DIRECTIONS FOR USETake LUPISULIDE P TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. SIDE EFFECTS OF LUPISULIDE P TABLETCOMMON Dizziness, excess sleepiness Stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea Peripheral oedema (swelling in legs/arms) Signs of hypersensitivity reactions such as skin rash, red itchy welts, itching, and shortness of breath RAREStop taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: Signs of severe allergic reactions such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the mouth/face, and/or shortness of breath Skin rash/peeling, mouth ulcers Breathing problems, unexplained bruising/bleeding Signs of impaired liver function such as nausea, sudden weight loss, loss of appetite, and yellowing of the eyes and skin HOW TO MANAGE SIDE EFFECTSDiarrheaDrink plenty of water and stay hydrated. Try to avoid taking any medicine on your own to manage diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the diarrhea does not improve. Dizziness Or DrowsinessTry to rest and get enough sleep. Try to avoid driving or operating any tools or machines while you feel dizzy. Limit consumption of alcohol, as it can aggravate dizziness. Consult your doctor if the dizziness worsens. Nausea And VomitingTry to take LUPISULIDE P TABLET with or just after a meal or a snack. Stick to simple meals. Avoid eating rich or spicy food. Consult your doctor if the nausea and vomiting get worse. WARNING & PRECAUTIONSPREGNANCYContraindicatedLUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Consult your doctor before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. BREASTFEEDINGContraindicatedLUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. DRIVING AND USING MACHINESUse with CautionDo not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, drowsy, and/or sleepy after taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. ALCOHOLContraindicatedAvoid consumption of alcohol while taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET because it might cause liver damage. KIDNEYConsult your doctorLUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and/or analgesic nephropathy. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. LIVERContraindicatedLUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. ALLERGYContraindicatedDo not take LUPISULIDE P TABLET if you are allergic to nimesulide, paracetamol, other NSAIDS, and/or other ingredients of this medicine. HEART DISEASEUse with CautionLUPISULIDE P TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. USE IN PEDIATRICSContraindicatedLUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child. USE IN GERIATRICSUse with CautionLUPISULIDE P TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. OTHERSLUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use if you: Have peptic ulcers and/or gastrointestinal bleeding Before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET, inform your doctor if you: Are alcohol dependent INTERACTIONSA. Drug-drug interactions: Before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine: Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage blood clotting) Ex. warfarin Cholestyramine (medicine used to lower high cholesterol levels) Metoclopramide, domperidone (medicines used to manage nausea and vomiting) B. Drug-food interaction: Avoid consumption of foods containing caffeine and/or drinks such as tea, chocolate, and coffee since it leads to excessive dizziness and sleepiness. Overdosage: If you or anyone else accidentally took more of LUPISULIDE P TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. SYNOPSIS Drug : Nimesulide, Paracetamol Pharmacological Category : Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs Therapeutic Indication : Osteoarthritic pain, Fever, Dysmenorrhea Dosage Forms : Tablet, Capsule, Suspension MORE INFORMATIONSTORAGE Keep LUPISULIDE P TABLET out of reach of children Store LUPISULIDE P TABLET in a cool, dry place FAQs ABOUT LUPISULIDE P TABLETQ: What is LUPISULIDE P TABLET used for? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET is used for pain relief, headache, muscle pain, dental pain, joint pain, back pain, menstrual pain, sprains, strains, sports injuries, and other forms of painful conditions. Q: When can I notice pain relief after using LUPISULIDE P TABLET? A: You may notice that your pain subsides within 1 hour of using LUPISULIDE P TABLET. It may take a day to show significant effects. However, this period can vary from person to person based on their health condition. Q: How long does it take for LUPISULIDE P TABLET to show its effects? A: You might observe that relief from your pain occurs within an hour of taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET. Significant effects may take up to a day to manifest, although this timeframe can vary depending on individual health conditions. Q: Is LUPISULIDE P TABLET a good painkiller? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET is commonly used as a painkiller and is generally considered effective for relieving various types of pain. It contains a combination of active ingredients, including nimesulide and paracetamol, which work together to alleviate pain and reduce inflammation. However, like any medication, its effectiveness can vary from person to person, and it's essential to use it as directed by a healthcare professional to ensure safety and maximum benefit. If you have specific concerns or medical conditions, it's advisable to consult with a doctor before using LUPISULIDE P TABLET or any other painkiller. Q: Does LUPISULIDE P TABLET contain paracetamol? A: Yes. LUPISULIDE P TABLET is a combination of paracetamol and nimesulide, which collectively work together for alleviating pain and inflammation. Q: Is LUPISULIDE P TABLET used for fever? A: Although LUPISULIDE P TABLET contains paracetamol, a fever-reducing agent, at the dosage of 325 mg, it is effective in alleviating pain and inflammation rather than reducing fever. However, it can be used to control very mild fever and body pain in exceptional circumstances. Q: Is LUPISULIDE P TABLET good for stomach pain? A: No. Do not take LUPISULIDE P TABLET if you have stomach pain. As LUPISULIDE P TABLET could generally increase your stomach acid secretion, it could worsen your existing condition. Therefore, check with your doctor for managing stomach pain. Q: Can I consume two tablets of LUPISULIDE P TABLET together for faster pain relief? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET is usually prescribed as one tab (2–3 times daily). Taking two tablets in one shot may lead to overdosage and unnecessary reactions. Therefore, stick to the dosage and frequency suggested by your doctor. If you feel that the prescribed dose is not working well for you, inform your doctor. Your doctor might suggest a suitable alternative. Q: Can I use LUPISULIDE P TABLET for long-term? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET is usually prescribed for short-term pain management. Taking it on a long-term basis without medical supervision may severely damage your liver and overall health. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it on a long-term basis. Q: What are the long-term side effects of using LUPISULIDE P TABLET? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET should be used only for short-term periods. Long-term usage is more likely to cause liver damage. If you are using LUPISULIDE P TABLET based on a doctor's advice, such unnecessary side effects can be avoided. Q: Can I take LUPISULIDE P TABLET daily? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET can be taken daily if requested by your doctor. However, please note that it should be followed only for a short period of time (not more than 4 weeks). Q: Does LUPISULIDE P TABLET damage your liver? A: Prolonged or overdosage of LUPISULIDE P TABLET has been reported to cause liver damage. Hence, use this medicine for the exact duration as advised by your doctor and stop it. Q: Is LUPISULIDE P TABLET banned for use in children? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 12 years of age. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. Q: Does LUPISULIDE P TABLET have side effects? A: The most common side effects of LUPISULIDE P TABLET are dizziness, excess sleepiness, stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, and/or peripheral oedema (swelling in the legs and arms). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. Q: Can LUPISULIDE P TABLET be used in pregnant women? A: Consult your doctor before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET if you are pregnant, as it is not known how this medicine reacts with an unborn baby. Q: Can I consume alcohol while taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET? A: Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET because it might cause liver damage. Q: What precautions must be taken while using LUPISULIDE P TABLET? A: Before taking LUPISULIDE P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a kidney problem, heart failure, or alcohol dependence. Q: Who should not take LUPISULIDE P TABLET? A: Do not take LUPISULIDE P TABLET if you are allergic to Nimesulide, Paracetamol, or other NSAIDS, or if you have severe kidney disease and/or analgesic nephropathy, liver disease, peptic ulcer, and/or gastrointestinal bleeding. Consult your doctor before taking it. Q: Is LUPISULIDE P TABLET safe for kids? A: LUPISULIDE P TABLET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). composition: NODARD PLUS TABLET is a combination of Nimesulide and Paracetamol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs. NODARD PLUS TABLET is used to provide relief from inflammation and pain in conditions such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses in affected individuals. NODARD PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to nimesulide, paracetamol, and/or other NSAIDS. It is also not recommended for use in patients with peptic ulcers, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe liver disease, and/or severe kidney disease. Before taking NODARD PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are alcohol dependent and/or have other kidney problems and/or heart problems such as heart failure. NODARD PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). NODARD PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor. The most common side effects of NODARD PLUS TABLET are dizziness, excess sleepiness, stomach upset, nausea, abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, and/or peripheral oedema (swelling in legs or arms). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen. USES OF NODARD PLUS TABLET Provides relief from inflammation and pain in conditions (such as headache, mild migraine, muscle pain, dental pain, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, osteoarthritis, and/or painful menses) in affected individuals. HOW NODARD PLUS TABLET WORKSNODARD PLUS TABLET provides relief from pain and inflammation, where nimesulide and paracetamol act by blocking the action of prostaglandin (chemical messengers responsible for pain and inflammation), resulting in reduced inflammation and providing relief from pain in affected individuals. DIRECTIONS FOR USETake NODARD PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition. Try to avoid taking any medicine on your own to manage diarrhea. Consult your doctor if the diarrhea does not improve. Dizziness Or DrowsinessTry to rest and get enough sleep. Try to avoid driving or operating any tools or machines while you feel dizzy. Limit consumption of alcohol, as it can aggravate dizziness. Consult your doctor if the dizziness worsens. Consult your doctor if the nausea and vomiting get worse. WARNING & PRECAUTIONSPREGNANCYContraindicatedNODARD PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy. Consult your doctor before taking NODARD PLUS TABLET. BREASTFEEDINGContraindicatedNODARD PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking NODARD PLUS TABLET. ALCOHOLContraindicatedAvoid consumption of alcohol while taking NODARD PLUS TABLET because it might cause liver damage. KIDNEYConsult your doctorNODARD PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and/or analgesic nephropathy. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking NODARD PLUS TABLET. LIVERContraindicatedNODARD PLUS TABLET is not recommended in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking NODARD PLUS TABLET. ALLERGYContraindicatedDo not take NODARD PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to nimesulide, paracetamol, other NSAIDS, and/or other ingredients of this medicine.
